incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple model-serving nodes reporting evictions and container restarts in us-west-2-gpu-1 pool. Error class: OOM during model init; CUDA driver resets seen. Auto-escalating to #incidents-mgmt

maya (oncall): seeing same in the dashboard, latency spike ~4x. KPUs evicted repeatedly. attaching last 2 logs.

lee (sre): paste from node logs: `kernel: NVRM: GPU 0: GPU has fallen off the bus.` `containerd: OOM killed process 1234 (model-server)` also `dlopen failed: unexpected eof while reading object` — looks like artifact read failures + OOM.

omar (runtime): likely warmup path failing. stack: `deserialize_weights -> allocate_kv_cache -> compile_kernels` — if deserialize partial and then allocation fails we abort. compile timeouts seen on warmup too: `JIT compile timed out after 90s` for kernel fsr_emt_128.

nina (support): customers A and C report 5xxs; support note: "models error 503 on inference, intermittent since 15:02 PDT". Need impact estimate for comms.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) disable aggressive prefetch/pipelined warmup on affected pool 2) route traffic to fallback smaller-quantized variants 3) cordon and evacuate flapping nodes. Can ops do cordon? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Received. Initiating cordon for nodes: usw2-gpu-1a-[12,14,15]. Starting drain with grace 60s.

lee (sre): quick check — eviction pattern shows memory blowup during artifact unpack on mount. Hypothesis: corrupted artifact causing repeated partial deserializations that leak temporary allocations. We should mark artifact suspect and fallback to previous artifact version.

omar (runtime): agree. Steps: - mark artifact v7 as bad in artifact registry - set fallback to v6 for models in that route - patch runtime to abort earlier on deserialization checksum mismatch (short-term) - increase compile timeout to 180s as temporary to avoid premature aborts for some kernel variants

maya (oncall): I'm switching routing via policy: all prod routes for that model -> fallback: `model-x@v6` and scale up dedicated small instances in eu-west for load spillover. Starting config change now. @omar please confirm compatibility.

omar (runtime): confirmed v6 compatible. Patching rollout: adding config `warmup.prefetch=false` and `compile.timeout=180s` for the pool. Will push hotfix to runtime in ~6m.

lee (sre): also saw one node with repeated `nvml: driver reset` messages; we should replace that host after drain. I've flagged it to infra.

nina (support): customer impact: ~2.3% of total requests returned 5xx during the 15:02-15:22 window. Affected customers: A, C, and one mid-market customer reported degradation. Draft comms: "We experienced transient model init failures causing elevated error rates; traffic shifted to fallback models; remediation applied. Follow-up with root cause will be provided"

maya (oncall): handoff: I'm paged out at 15:35. @lee you'll take next oncall at 15:40 — please verify node replacements completed and artifact registry rollback is stable. Leave summary in incident ticket.

lee (sre): taking over. current status: routing to v6 confirmed, affected pool drained, node replacements queued, runtime hotfix deployed to 3/4 hosts. Monitoring for re-occurrence.

omar (runtime): follow-up note: we'll add an integrity check on artifact download (checksum+size+manifest) and fail fast before allocating big GPU buffers. I'll open PR and link in postmortem. Also add metrics for compile timeout count.

maya (oncall): thanks team. tagging for postmortem: cause = corrupted artifact + insufficient pre-warm fail-fast + compile timeout too low; mitigations = artifact rollback, cordon/replace nodes, runtime hotfix, routing fallback. Action owners: Omar (runtime fix), Lee (node replacement + infra follow-up), Nina (customer comms).

ops-bot: cordon/drain complete for nodes listed; replacements scheduled and booting.

lee (sre): last check 15:50 PDT — error rate back to baseline, no new evictions in the last 5m. I'll keep the ticket open until 18:00 for follow-up verification.

nina (support): sent initial comms to affected customers, ETA for RCA 48 hours.

maya (oncall): logging handoff note now. handed off to @lee. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigation applied, monitoring. Incident severity: SEV3. Postmortem flag set."
